Senior Accountant, NimbusSoft — Feb 2025 - Present
Manage month-end close activities for a SaaS product company, reconciling vendor statements and ensuring timely disbursements. Implemented a standardized vendor onboarding checklist and automated TDS computation for contract vendors, reducing TDS reconciliation time by 40%. Oversee Accounts Payable workflow for recurring subscriptions and third-party services, enforcing payment schedules and early-payment discounts. Maintain books and prepare periodic reports using Tally Prime; coordinate with the external audit team and support GST-related queries raised during internal reviews. Use Git to manage versioned process documents and Jira to track accounting tasks and approvals.

Finance Executive, Orbit Health — Sep 2020 - Jan 2025
Processed high-volume supplier invoices and managed end-to-end Accounts Payable operations for clinical supplies and vendor services. Prepared and filed periodic TDS returns and maintained deduction records, improving on-time filing rates. Handled GST compliance including return preparation and reconciliations, resolving mismatches with suppliers. Managed accounting entries and ledgers in Tally Prime, implemented vendor-wise aging reports to prioritize payments and reduce overdue payables by 25%. Tracked approval workflows and exceptions using Jira; maintained process documentation in Git repositories.

Tally Prime, GST, TDS, Accounts Payable, Git, Jira
